detailsNote: Fall 2027 early deadline confirmed. Other dates are reproduced as published without an unstated calendar year; admission model is not stated.

english.note: ielts: 6.5 overall; no band below 6.0. Graduate School policy accepts TOEFL/IELTS. Foreign English-medium degree exemption requires the policy's qualifying country/institution conditions and admissions approval; do not assume automatic exemption.

requirements.note: Accredited bachelor's degree or international equivalent; overall and undergraduate GPA minimum 3.0. Biology, chemistry, mathematics and physics preparation is recommended, not required. Graduate Admissions states it does not offer application fee waivers; amount not established on checked pages. Reference table requires a professor; supervisors/managers also accepted. Friends, family, coworkers, clergy and other evaluator types are not accepted.
